title: An editing session walk runs at Next defaults and fails on any blink
goal: Nothing has ever checked the video editor end to end the way a person gets it, with default settings, or measured whether playback blinks. Add one scripted editing session that runs at Next defaults and fails on any blank frame.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): Nothing ever checked the video experience end to end as a user gets it, and nothing measured playback stability. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: One walk, no flags forced: open a recording, cut it, add a second clip, a title that moves A to B, a transition, captions, export MP4
During playback it photographs 20+ moments and fails if the clip area is ever empty
It is part of the rotating check and named in the video epic's success criteria

log.note: triage 2026-09-23: goal rewritten in plain language, the old one kept at the top of notes

video-shell.html was deleted on 2026-09-23 (task the-video-mocks-are-the-user-s-again-and-d18-is): it was the loop's own study arguing against tracks. The target is now pages/video.html, the video-*.html walkthroughs and comp-video.html, restored as the user drew them, plus UX-PATTERNS D18 (rewritten: a document with time has tracks). Where this task mentions video-shell, read video.html.

adversarial review before: a Premiere editor's first edit is cut, add b-roll, smooth a jump cut, a title, captions, export; the walk does exactly that with Premiere's keys (Cmd K, Delete) and the picker at the cut. The existing blink check only watched the first clip in the list, which is off screen for most of an edited document, so it was rewritten to follow whichever clips are on at each look.

found and fixed: any document with captions pushed the right panel ~26pt past the window's right edge (Style segmented bar beside a row label cannot shrink); it now spans the section as the mock's #styleSeg does. Checked in captions-write-themselves-walk capture.

found and filed: captions do not follow a ripple delete (cutting-a-stretch-out-of-a-recording-takes-its-c, p1); export sheet said 9.6 MB for a 0.7 MB MP4 (the-export-sheet-s-size-for-an-edited-video-is-c, p2); Edit point 'Spare before' shows '...' (folded into a-transition-can-sit-before-across-or-after-the).

left rough: the Captions Generate row squeezes its button to 'Write Ag...' beside '10 captions' (CaptionsInspector generate row); a label nit, did not earn a task. Also left rough: the blink check reads the picture handed to the canvas, not the screen itself.

Shipped in 48bd8826. New walk an-editing-session-walk at Next defaults with no flags: talking recording captions itself, Cmd K x2 + Delete cut, b-roll onto V1, cross dissolve from the picker on the jump cut, title keyed A to B by a canvas drag, 21s of playback looked at 30 times (expectPlaybackNeverBlank now follows whichever clips are on), MP4 written 20.94s with sound. ~55s, 7 real captures, screen unlocked. It runs first in every rotating check (sweep-schedule everyCheck + drill) and is named in the video epic's success criteria. Fixed: captioned documents pushed the right panel off the window (caption Style bar now spans the section like the mock). Scripts/test.sh 9534/9534; neighbour walks ok (playing-a-recording-never-blinks, captions-write-themselves, captions-from-the-sound, transition-picker-at-a-cut, second-clip-on-the-timeline, key-a-title-s-scale). Audit queue/audits/2026-09-24-editing-session-walk.json. Follow-ups: cutting-a-stretch-out-of-a-recording-takes-its-c (p1), the-export-sheet-s-size-for-an-edited-video-is-c (p2).
